= PlantUML Syntax Error

The third line of the block is not PlantUML, so the renderer rejects the diagram and the
run has to fail with it. asciidoctor-diagram supplies the `@startuml`/`@enduml` frame for
a bare block, so the syntax error is the whole of what makes this fail — not the absent
markers.

The offending statement is the one the validate fixture of the same name uses,
deliberately — two different bets on what PlantUML refuses would mean one suite silently
stops testing the failure path it was written for.

[plantuml]
----
Alice -> Bob : hello
!!! this line is not PlantUML at all (((
----
